sentences.text:
Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.45774 Of 2022
Order:

This writ petition is filed to declare action of respondent No.2- Station House Officer, Kothur Police Station, in interfering in the civil disputes in respect of the lands admeasuring Ac.0-25 guntas,
Ac.1-15 guntas and Ac.3-00 guntas in Survey Nos.133/1, 133/U and 133/2, respectively, situated at Siddapur Revenue Village, Kothur Mandal, Ranga Reddy District.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, and perused the material available on record.
3.
On 23.12.2022, this Court passed interim order directing respondent No.2 not to interfere in civil disputes in connection with subject lands without following due process of law.

4. As per the written instructions received by the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home,
on a complaint lodged by one Megavath Narender, First Information Report No.238 of 2022 of Kothur (M) Police Station was registered for the offences under Sections 420 and 506 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The petitioner is Accused No.3 in the said First Information Report.
During the course of investigation, notice under Section 41-A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short, 'Cr.P.C') was issued to the petitioner (Accused No.3) on 19.12.2022.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that subsequent to issuance of the notice dated 19.12.2022 under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C., several such notices were issued to the petitioner.

6. In the above circumstances, this writ petition is disposed of directing respondent No.2-Station House Officer, Kothur Police Station, not to interfere in the civil disputes without following due process of law.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in the writ petition stand closed.
